recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-38841 core source change without disturbing the later FHIR-48492 jurisdiction reversal; further topic-policy changes would need a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-38841 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested deprecating MetadataResource.topic and CanonicalResource.jurisdiction, defining usage-context-type codes for topic and jurisdiction, and adding definition-topic and jurisdiction value sets to the UsageContext values example value set.
initial_application: The historical application commit 49b86f8a69 updated CanonicalResource, MetadataResource, and definition pattern source. Current source already deprecates MetadataResource.topic and recommends useContext.code http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/usage-context-type#topic, but valueset-use-context was not updated with definition-topic or THO jurisdiction.
additional_context: UP-401 implemented the THO usage-context-type topic and jurisdiction codes. FHIR-39632 and its reconciliation confirm current UsageContext code references should use the THO CodeSystem URL. FHIR-48492 later reversed only the jurisdiction deprecation, so CanonicalResource.jurisdiction is intentionally active while useContext may still carry jurisdictions of use.
reconciliation: Added http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction and http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/definition-topic includes to source/terminologies/valueset-use-context.xml. No jurisdiction deprecation text was reintroduced because FHIR-48492 supersedes that part of the R5 decision.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue reverses the CanonicalResource.jurisdiction deprecation while leaving useContext available for jurisdictions of use.
UTG proposal implemented the THO usage-context-type topic and jurisdiction codes referenced by the FHIR-38841 migration guidance.
Later core terminology cleanup confirms usage-context-type references should point at the THO CodeSystem URL.
